display.purpose: The hero statement. Once per page.

label.purpose: The machine voice: navigation, field names, captions, legal, numbers. One size and one tracking everywhere on the site.

wordmark.purpose: The lockup only. Nippo appears nowhere else.

shadows.name: glass-lift
shadows.purpose: The only shadow on the site. Separates a glass pane from the footage behind it. Never used on flat ground.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Control fills: background, colour and border together.

motion.name: ground
motion.purpose: The masthead crossing between grounds, and the mark's colour with it.

motion.name: reel
motion.purpose: The engagements reel. Deliberately unshaped: with snapping a gesture is a jump of a whole engagement, and an eased curve spends it crossing far faster in the middle than at the ends, so the card flicks past instead of travelling. The pacing belongs to the snap animation.

narrative.premise: A real place at a real hour, read coolly. Live footage behind, instrument in front. Nothing is decorated; things are measured.
antiReferences: The dark statement-panel arrangement the previous site shipped
The card-grid consultancy page: six things offered at once instead of one

rules.name: The One Rule
rules.text: Slate is the ink, electric is the signal. Blue never carries running prose: at 5.34:1 it has no room to fade, so a tinted secondary blue collapses and the band goes flat. It is spent in fewer places rather than made louder.

rules.name: The Single Source Rule
rules.text: All colour is decided in src/styles/palettes.css and nowhere else, so one attribute on <html> repaints both planes including the WebGL field. A literal colour elsewhere is a bug.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.text: Fragment Mono for anything a machine would have printed; Switzer for anything a person says. Nothing is set in both, and there is no third family.

rules.name: The One Size Rule
rules.text: The machine voice appears at exactly one size and one tracking everywhere. Fragment Mono ships a single weight, which is a feature: there is never a decision to make about it.

rules.name: The No-Border Rule
rules.text: Glass panes have no border. A hairline draws the pane's outline, which reads as a shape; the shadow separates it from what is behind, which reads as a sheet lying on top. 50px of blur resolves everything behind to one flat field, so the pane becomes a material rather than a window.

rules.name: The Snap Marker Rule
rules.text: Every full-height panel needs a .site-stop marker immediately before it. Page snapping is mandatory, which means the scroll can never rest anywhere that is not a snap position, so a panel without one becomes unreachable. Deleting these markers once forced a retreat to proximity snapping and broke the engagements reel for a full session.

components.name: Control
components.description: Drawn, never filled. A rule with the machine voice inside it; the fill arrives on hover and it is the ink.
components.css: .ds-control { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.75rem; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0 1.75rem; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: #181d26; font-family: "Fragment Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-control:hover { background: #181d26; color: #e8edf5; }

components.name: Control, solid
components.description: One per page, for the single action the hero asks for. On a washed photograph a drawn rule is a suggestion; a solid plate is an instruction.
components.css: .ds-control-solid { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0 1.75rem; border: 1px solid #e8edf5; border-radius: 4px; background: #e8edf5; color: #181d26; font-family: "Fragment Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-control-solid:hover { background: #fff; border-color: #fff; }

components.name: Glass
components.description: The front plane's only material, and only ever over the footage. A film of light, a deep blur, a soft shadow, and no border.
components.css: .ds-glass { display: inline-flex; gap: 1.5rem; align-items: center; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; background: rgba(226, 230, 238, 0.1); border: 0; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 4px 35px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15); backdrop-filter: blur(50px) saturate(130%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(50px) saturate(130%); color: #e8edf5; font-family: "Fragment Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Label
components.description: The machine voice. Anything a system would have printed rather than a person written.
components.css: .ds-label { font-family: "Fragment Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1; color: #181d26; }

components.name: Field
components.description: No box. A baseline with the label above it in the machine voice; the rule takes the electric on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-field span { font-family: "Fragment Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgb(24 29 38 / 0.66); } .ds-field input { border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(24 29 38 / 0.28); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; padding: 0.6rem 0; color: #181d26; font-family: Switzer, sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-bottom: 2px solid #0047ff; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: A full-height band holding one idea. Inverts its whole subtree rather than restating colour on its children.
components.html:
Three ways I work

Each engagement is scoped around the operating problem in front of you.
components.css: .ds-panel { display: grid; align-content: center; gap: 1.5rem; min-height: 60vh; padding: clamp(1.5rem, 5.5vh, 10rem) clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3.5rem); background: #e8edf5; color: #181d26; border-radius: 0; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0; font-family: Switzer, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 5vw, 5.4rem); font-weight: 520; line-height: 0.95; letter-spacing: -0.03em; color: #0047ff; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; max-width: 46ch; font-size: 1.2rem; line-height: 1.6; color: rgb(24 29 38 / 0.66); }
